01

Principal and rewards stand apart.

You can withdraw all principal even below the threshold. Withdraw does not claim rewards; unclaimed rewards are forfeited. Smart contract wallets must be able to receive ETH to recover principal.

02

Every deposit starts the clock again.

Every Deposit, including a top-up, clears unclaimed rewards. Tokens already claimed remain yours. More principal does not increase an address’s daily issuance rate.

03

No administrator. No special privileges.

The contract has no owner, upgrade or pause mechanism. The threshold rises by 0.1 ETH every 1,000 days from genesis. Losing eligibility does not erase previously accrued rewards.
